verifiers.claim: The person's action and the agent's page command run the same tool: same schema refusal, same result, same state; an agent request over the bridge changes the viewer exactly as the control does.

In a browser on the registry host (items installed with shadcn add): the scripted agent reads and proposes through the editor's tools, the person accepts and the save carries the provider's receipt; a stale save shows the conflict banner and keeps both versions; the tree shows a file the agent wrote; the agent zooms and highlights the image; the agent draws on the tldraw canvas and the .tldraw file carries the shapes at the receipt's revision; /code opens read-only; light and dark screenshots of every item.

A read-only viewer offers no write tool and its provider refuses: saving a read-only document or creating under a read-only root is denied and leaves content and receipts unchanged, even on a writable provider.
Local tools answer applied and leave no receipt; proposals answer proposed; committed results carry the provider's receipt with both revisions; stale, conflict and denied change nothing.
A mounted viewer registers its tools as one page bound to its document; after it moves to another document a request made for the first is answered stale and the handler does not run.

A save after another writer changed the file is a conflict that keeps the buffer and the newer file; overwrite writes only at the revision the person has now seen; apply_patch at an old revision is stale and with unsaved edits is a conflict. On the canvas: a stale save of the person's drawing is a conflict; update_shapes at an old version is stale and over unsaved changes a conflict.
propose_patch saves nothing; no tool accepts; the person's accept saves with a receipt; a proposal that no longer applies is stale on accept.
The lint configuration refuses viewers importing Flue, the agent package, Node or the directory/GitHub entry of files, and accepts files/web, chat and React.
viewers imports only what ARCHITECTURE.json allows: files, chat and react.
